hints.title: Problem Analysis
hints.text: A square field must have equal horizontal side length and vertical side length.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Horizontal fences are at 1, hFences, and m. Compute all possible differences between any pair of horizontal boundaries and store them in a set.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy
hints.text: Vertical fences are at 1, vFences, and n. Find the maximum difference between any pair of vertical boundaries that is also present in the horizontal differences set.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: size of input array or string
